donate.title: Donate
donate.intro: Every donation is shared transparently among the doers and counts toward coverage.
donate.needLogin: To coordinate a donation through the site please log in. You can also reach us directly via the links on this page.
donate.coordinateHelp: We'll let the rikma's members know you'd like to give; they'll reach out to arrange the transfer. Once received it is recorded as a donation.
donate.recordHelp: Log a donation that already arrived. If the money is held by another member they confirm receipt before it counts.
donate.name: Donor name (leave blank for anonymous)
donate.contact: How can we reach you? (phone / email)
donate.okReq: Thank you! The rikma has been notified and will reach out.
donate.okClaim: Recorded — awaiting the holder's confirmation (auto-approves after the response time).
donate.needHolder: Please choose who holds the money

supportToggle.title: Support & donations page
supportToggle.desc: Controls who can see the public support page — where people donate, volunteer and view the transparent coverage board.
